customer-42: Hey team, hitting weird embedding dims. Passing one sentence and get back an array shape that doesn't match docs. Error snippet: `400 Bad Request: embedding vector length mismatch. expected 1536, got 1`

carmen (Support): Can you paste the request body you sent (no API key)? small repro is best. Also which client (language/version) and model?

customer-42: Using Python requests, model: text-embed-1 (1536d). Body I send: ```json
{
  \"input\": \"[\\\"We ship at dawn\\\"]\"
}
```
I know, weird — I json.dumps my payload and the inner array gets double-encoded by my wrapper. Server accepts it but returns mismatch.

raj (SDK): Ah that looks like the culprit — the inner array is a string containing JSON for an array, so the inference service reads it as a single string token and then the embedder treats it as a scalar. For a single item you can send either `{"input": "text"}` or `{"input": ["text"]}` but not a JSON-encoded string of an array.

customer-42: For context my code: ```py
data = {"input": json.dumps([text])}
resp = requests.post(url, json=data, headers=headers)
```
I thought I had to ensure JSON, turns out requests.json= already does.

olivia (Infra): That double-encoding also affects batching throughput — the server will try to interpret each top-level element. If you pass a single string that looks like an array, the tokenizer count can explode, leading to high latency and cost. Any chance you hit 413 or timeout?

customer-42: We saw a spike in token counts in logs and one 504 for a large batch. We also saw `embedding vector length mismatch` only for some requests where the client accidentally wrapped an array as a string.

carmen (Support): Recommended fix: send payload as either: ```json
{"input": "We ship at dawn"}
```
or```json
{"input": ["We ship at dawn"]}
```
If using requests, do NOT json.dumps the inner value. Example fix: ```py
# WRONG
data = {"input": json.dumps([text])}
# RIGHT
data = {"input": [text]}
resp = requests.post(url, json=data, headers=headers)
```

raj (SDK): We'll add a better error message when the inner field is a string that parses as JSON array — currently it surfaces as a generic length mismatch. Also adding a quick client-side validation: if input is a string and looks like JSON array, warn. Filing SDK issue #438.

customer-42: Thanks — that explains the shape mismatch. Any tips to detect this server-side earlier?

olivia (Infra): On our end we can detect double-encoded arrays and return `400: inputs should be array or string, not JSON-encoded-array-string` — filing infra ticket to tighten validation and prevent weird tokenization spikes.

carmen (Support): For now, can you run `jq` check before sending? Quick rep repro: ```bash
echo '{"input":"[\"foo\"]"}' | jq .
# shows input as string -> fix needed
```

customer-42: Reproduced locally, fixed code, metrics back to normal. Appreciate the fast triage! :heart:

carmen (Support): Glad it helped. Leaving notes: support runbook updated with "double-encoded input" troubleshooting steps and sample fixed snippets. Closing once you confirm stable for 24h.

customer-42: Will confirm tomorrow. Thanks all! :+1:
